committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 23 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing page test has run up 55 raw paid clicks for $345.80 ex GST since 6 Oct, with $200.01 of the $600 credit left and zero qualified enquiries logged against it, so cost per qualified enquiry can't yet be checked against the A$480 pause rule as clicks head toward the 75-click red-flag mark.

No external account changes this week (externalLast24h and externalLast7d both at 0, status ok), so the test numbers aren't contaminated by outside edits; impression share sits at 10% with 74.2% of impressions lost to rank, well above the 19.7% lost to budget, so the budget-versus-rank trigger hasn't fired.

Since the page launch, ask_cta_click sits at 10 and review_cta_click at 0, so visitors are only taking the lighter question-form step; with 55 total paid clicks already past the 25-click mark, headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen while the homepage (31 sessions) is still pulling more entries than /automate.html (18 sessions).

AI Assistant sessions moved from 0 to 3 this week, all via chatgpt.com, worth watching given the answer-engine work, but it likely undercounts given Direct jumped from 6 to 36 and may be absorbing more untagged AI clicks; the only trustworthy unpaid signal, Organic Search, actually fell from 15 to 9 sessions.

actions.text: Paid clicks are at 55, well past the 25-click checkpoint, so leave the headline, offer and CTAs frozen unless something breaks. Watch the count as it closes in on the 75-click red-flag threshold with zero qualified enquiries so far.
Sort the logo and image assets for the Agency ad group, the one still taking essentially all the paid clicks.
Update the RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads (Job Intake, SimPRO): they still claim 13.3 hours of admin saved per week and 99.6% success, which no longer matches the current site stats.

weekly: 55 raw paid clicks and $345.80 ex GST spent since 6 Oct, with $200.01 of the $600 credit left and zero qualified enquiries logged yet, so the page stays frozen past its 25-click checkpoint as it heads toward the 75-click red-flag mark.
last 7 days hit 69 sessions against 43 the week before, up 60%, with Thu 22's 13 sessions well ahead of the 9 recorded on the same weekday the previous week, Thu 15.
generate_lead sat at zero again this week and the test log still shows no qualified enquiries against the 10 ask_cta_click form starts recorded since the landing page launched.
Direct and AI Assistant traffic both jumped

Direct rose from 6 to 36 sessions and AI Assistant sessions went from 0 to 3, all via chatgpt.com, though Direct likely hides further AI referrals with no referrer rather than genuine organic demand, while Organic Search itself fell from 15 to 9 sessions.
data only runs through Tue 20 Oct, two days behind, with just 6 clicks from 245 impressions over 8 days and the branded term kontrol the only query ranking well, at position 1.
